name: railing
description: a rusted iron railing that creaks ominously when you lean on it. it's not safe, but it's held for 130 years. one section is wrapped with a faded ribbon — a woman's hair ribbon, blue silk.

params.success_message: the blue silk ribbon tied to the railing is old but well-preserved. it's tied in a complex knot — a lover's knot. someone stood here, looking out at the garden, waiting for someone who never came.
